snippet.title: Bug Alliance - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Bug Alliance is a top-down Action Roguelite where every level-up reshapes your build. Trigger Synergies, conquer 20-wave maps with boss finales, unlock a 13-chapter story on higher difficulties-then dive into Chaos Surge with endless bosses, curses, and risky rewards.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018360/Bug_Alliance/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
